requirements.text: The box body measures 100 mm x 70 mm x 50 mm (length x width x height).
The lid is a separate body from the box and is not fused to it as a single solid.
The lid is attached to the box by two pin hinges, each with one pin.
Both hinges are located along the back edge of the box where the lid meets the box.
The lid rotates about the common hinge axis running along the back edge, which is the axis of the two pins.
Each hinge pin has a diameter of 4 mm.
The box has knuckles that the hinge pins pass through.
The lid has knuckles that the hinge pins pass through.
Each pin passes through both a box knuckle and a lid knuckle.
There is 0.3 mm clearance between each pin and its knuckle holes.
The two pins are coaxial so the lid can rotate freely.
